name: Lunar Conflux Barrier
desc:
A barrier formed after pure kuuvahki energy condenses. There may be unexpected things sealed within it...
Attack using objects Suffused with kuuvahki, or unleash kuuvahki by other means to cause them to enter the Suffused state. The barrier will melt as a result.

imgDesc.text:
A barrier formed after pure kuuvahki energy condenses. There may be unexpected things sealed within it...
Attack using objects Suffused with kuuvahki, or unleash kuuvahki by other means to cause them to enter the
Suffused state. The barrier will melt as a result.

However, if the barrier is large, it will require multiple charges for it to become
Suffused. By observing the surface of the barrier, you can gauge its current charging progress.

Once fully charged, the Lunar Conflux Barrier will reveal the objects sealed within, becoming
Suffused in the process. At this stage, the Lunar Conflux Barrier will also recharge objects which are susceptible to kuuvahki.
